provenance: All fixtures are synthetic. No Allianz or real customer data.

cases.name: baseline
cases.description: Synthetic multi-account baseline; preserves original final-account EOF defect.

cases.name: empty
cases.description: No category records means no transactions or account changes.

cases.name: single_account_eof
cases.description: Only one processed account: transaction exists but original never rewrites that account.

cases.name: negative_rate
cases.description: Signed rate and signed balance; truncation is toward zero.

cases.name: fractional_rate
cases.description: Decimal annual percentage rate, with positive and negative truncation.

cases.name: inactive_account
cases.description: Original has no active-status filter: preserve this behavior.

cases.name: input_order
cases.description: Indexed input determines key order, not supplied fixture row order.

cases.name: missing_account
cases.description: Missing account aborts before any rate-based guard.

cases.name: missing_xref
cases.description: Missing cross-reference aborts, rather than silently dropping a category.

cases.name: missing_default
cases.description: Missing account-specific and matching DEFAULT rates aborts.
